question: Where was the 13th Economic and Financial Dialogue between India and the UK held?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**London**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India, UK reaffirm commitment to boost ties in financial services, FinTech, digital economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Economic and Financial Dialogue:**

 
 
• 
 
The **13th Economic and Financial Dialogue** between **India** and the **UK** was held in **London**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Indian delegation** was led by **Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman**.

 
 
• 
 
The **UK delegation** was led by **Chancellor of the Exchequer Rachel Reeves**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Focus Areas:**

 
 
• 
 
Both countries reaffirmed their commitment to collaboration in the **financial services sector**, **FinTech**, and the **digital economy**.

 
 
• 
 
They emphasized **enhancing economic growth** through strengthening **bilateral relations**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Trade and Investment:**

 
 
• 
 
The two sides are actively working on a **free trade agreement** (FTA) and a **bilateral investment treaty**.

 
 
• 
 
They agreed on the importance of a **strong UK-India relationship** to enhance **trade**, **supply chain resilience**, and collaboration on **global challenges**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Bilateral Goals:**

 
 
• 
 
A focus on **mutually beneficial agreements** to bolster both countries' economies and foster resilience in the global context.
